Description of Action:  Insert customer’s office (e.g., The Logistics Modernization Program Project Office) requests a type of contract (e.g., firm-fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, etc.) bridge task order, bridge delivery order or bridge modification to W52P1J/W519TC-XX-X-XXXX with contractor name.  ACC-RI will execute this action against the insert multiple award contract name (e.g., Computer Hardware, Enterprise Software and Solutions (CHESS) Information Technology Enterprise Solutions - 3 Hardware (ITES-3H)) contract.  ACC-RI projects award for Month 20YY and will obligate fiscal year 20YY, funds type (e.g., Operations and Maintenance, Army or Other Procurement Army) funds.  Choose one of the following six scenarios to address the acquisition plan. Scenarios 1-4 apply to new orders, 5 and 6 apply to modifications to orders; while scenario 2 could apply to either a new order or a modification to an order. (1) An acquisition plan is not required because this procurement does not meet the threshold at Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 207.103(d)(i)(B). (2) An acquisition plan is not required in accordance with (IAW) Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 207.103(e) because this acquisition is included in the XXXX (e.g., LOGCAP) program level acquisition plan. (3) Approval authority title waived the detail and formality of the acquisition plan on date, in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation 7.103(m), due to the compressed delivery – or - performance schedule of the requirement. (4) Approval authority title approved an acquisition plan in accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 207.103(d)(i)(B) on date – or is currently awaiting approval authority title approval. (5) Approval authority title approved an acquisition plan in accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 207.103(d)(i)(B) on date for contract W52P1J/W519TC-XX-X-XXXX (refers to the original contract if a mod is being issued for the bridge). An amendment to the plan was required and was approved by approval authority title on date – or – is awaiting approval authority title approval. (6) Approval authority title approved an acquisition plan in accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 207.103(d)(i)(B) on date for contract W52P1J/W519TC-XX-X-XXXX (refers to the original contract if a mod is being issued for the bridge).  No amendment to the plan is required because position title determined the changes resulting from this modification are not significant because why.
